awakening_system.bestiary.abyssal_behold: • Abyssal Null Beam: Purple particle beam that strips positive buffs.
• Distortion Pulse: Gravitational sonic wave that launches hunters into the air.
• Dive Flight: Sudden high-speed aerial dive attack.
Concentrated Void Eye, Abyssal Tentacle, Telekinesis Crystal.
Colossal floating entities born from fissures in dimensional space, eternal sentinels of the darkest rifts.
Use bows or long-range magic while dodging its straight concentrated beam.
awakening_system.bestiary.abyssal_necrom: • Soul Volley: Homing dark projectiles inflicting blindness.
• Abyssal Curse: Necrotic mist applying Wither, Slowness, and Weakness.
• Raise Dead: Resurrects armored skeletons to shield against incoming attacks.
Necrotic Skull, Abyssal Soul Dust, Cursed Staff.
Arcane hermits who spent centuries in the forbidden study of death deep within dungeon depths.
Focus damage immediately on the necromancer so his summons fade away.
awakening_system.bestiary.anemo_hypostas: • Inviolable Cube Shell: Immune to damage while cubes protect its core.

Hurricane Seed, Vayuda Turquoise, Wind Elemental Prism.
Elemental lifeforms of ultimate purity having discarded biological structure to obey mathematical laws.
Wait for it to execute an attack, then strike the exposed core. Collect all wind orbs in final phase.
Beth - Pure Anemo Entity & Sacred Geometry
awakening_system.bestiary.ant_soldier.ab: • Crushing Mandibles: Lethal armor penetration at close range.
• Scythe Arms: Rapid high-frequency scissor cuts.
• Burst Flight: Winged rush with massive knockback.
awakening_system.bestiary.ant_soldier.dr: Reinforced Ant Chitin, Venomous Mandibles, Chimeric Essence.
awakening_system.bestiary.ant_soldier.lo: Mutant insect subspecies engineered for invasion and indiscriminate consumption of all living beings.
awakening_system.bestiary.ant_soldier.ta: Target its wings to force it to the ground where its movement is more predictable.
awakening_system.bestiary.ant_soldier.ti: Shock Chimera of the Jeju Colony
awakening_system.bestiary.antares.abilit: • Dragon's Breath: Continuous infernal flames that melt armor.
• Claws of Ruin: Brutal tear inflicting deep hemorrhaging.
• Meteor Shower: Devastating wide-radius fiery bombardment.
• Berserk Fury (Phase 2): Critical increase in impact damage and speed.
awakening_system.bestiary.antares.drops: Scales of the Destruction Dragon, Primordial Volcanic Core, Orb of Wrath.
awakening_system.bestiary.antares.lore: The King of Berserk Dragons and supreme antagonist. His sole purpose is reducing all creation to ash.
awakening_system.bestiary.antares.name: Antares
awakening_system.bestiary.antares.tactic: Equip extreme fire resistance potions and flank him after his heavy breath.
awakening_system.bestiary.antares.title: Monarch of Destruction (Solo Leveling)
awakening_system.bestiary.armored_lawach: • Implacable Geo Carapace: Stone armor reducing physical and magical damage by 80%.
• Cataclysmic Earth Leap: Leaps high and slams down producing massive shockwaves.
• Colossal Battering Ram: Frontal charge smashing through light structures.

A veteran giant hilichurl whose muscles and bones fused with earth minerals over centuries of survival.
Use Geo attacks or blunt greatsword/hammer strikes to break his stone armor.
Mitachurl Monarch of the Geo Armor
awakening_system.bestiary.ashborn.abilit: • Domain of Death: Drains life and plunges the area into Wither and Darkness.
• Ruler's Authority: Telekinesis that drags hunters toward his blade.
• 360 Great Slash: Devastating spinning sweep of the Shadow Greatsword.
• Shadow Extraction: Summons battalions of loyal spectral infantry.
awakening_system.bestiary.ashborn.drops: Heart of the Shadow Monarch, Essence of Death, Abyssal Crystals.
awakening_system.bestiary.ashborn.lore: The greatest Fragment of Brilliant Light reborn as the King of the Dead and absolute sovereign of eternal darkness.
awakening_system.bestiary.ashborn.name: Ashborn

awakening_system.bestiary.ashborn.title: Shadow Monarch (Solo Leveling)

• Storm Daggers: Dual lightning-fast flurries at supersonic speeds.
• Demon King's Tempest: Electrified skies with continuous lightning strikes.
• Demonic Summon: Summons legionnaires and celestial lightning orcs.
awakening_system.bestiary.baran.drops: Horn of Baran, Daggers of the Demonic Storm, White Lightning Essence.
awakening_system.bestiary.baran.lore: Sovereign of demonic nobility. His mastery of white flame and thunder made him one of the System's greatest nightmares.
awakening_system.bestiary.baran.name: Baran
awakening_system.bestiary.baran.tactics: Keep moving in circles to avoid celestial strikes and keep your shield raised.
awakening_system.bestiary.baran.title: Monarch of White Flames & Demon King
awakening_system.bestiary.beastman.abili: • Battle Roar: Intimidates nearby foes, reducing their attack power.
• Crushing Leap: Acrobatic jump that detonates with a shockwave upon landing.
• Blood Frenzy: Increases movement speed when detecting wounded prey.
awakening_system.bestiary.beastman.drops: Beast Fangs, Savage Leather, Magic Iron Ores.
awakening_system.bestiary.beastman.lore: Warrior tribes inhabiting the wild valleys of the Isekai dimension, loyal only to the law of the strongest.
awakening_system.bestiary.beastman.name: Beastman
awakening_system.bestiary.beastman.tacti: Interrupt his jump with heavy ranged attacks or magic projectiles.
awakening_system.bestiary.beastman.title: Fierce Warrior of the Isekai Steppes
awakening_system.bestiary.blood_disciple: • Boiling Blood Claws: Slashes that intensify the hunter's bleeding status.
• Blood Qi Shield: Spherical barrier absorbing damage and converting it to healing.
• Sanguine Detonation: Sacrifices a percentage of life to trigger a crimson pulse.
Blood Daggers, Scarlet Pearl, Marrow Cleansing Elixir.
Members of the feared Blood Sect whose doctrine proclaims supreme strength flows from stolen lifeblood.
Punish his shield with burst damage to shatter the barrier before it heals him.
Initiate of the Sanguine Blood Sea
awakening_system.bestiary.blood_orc.abil: • Brutal Slam: Leaps and smashes the ground, stunning targets in area.
• Berserker Rage: Dramatically increases damage as health depletes.
• Iron Skin: High resistance to knockback and physical slashing.
awakening_system.bestiary.blood_orc.drop: Bloodstained Tusks, Reinforced Leather, Elite Abyssal Axe.
awakening_system.bestiary.blood_orc.lore: Warriors mutated by subterranean dungeon mana whose thirst for combat is quenched only by total victory.
awakening_system.bestiary.blood_orc.name: Blood Orc

awakening_system.bestiary.blood_patriarc: • Boiling Sea of Blood: Floods the arena with suffocating pools of sanguine Qi.
• Totem of Blood Judgment: Summons totemic pillars channeling life-draining beams.
• Thousand Blood Blades: Omnidirectional volley of razor needles.
• Sanguine Rebirth: Recovers 25% health if consuming the essence of fallen disciples.
Blood Patriarch Staff, Crimson Sea Manual, Primordial Blood Heart.
A monstrous cultivator who attained corrupted immortality by sacrificing entire sects in Murim's golden age.
Destroy his blood totems immediately to prevent life drain and avoid blood puddles.
Supreme Blood Sect Leader & Lord of Crimson Qi
awakening_system.bestiary.cloud_crane.ab: • Misty Wind Gust: Whirlwind that launches attackers high into the air.
• Celestial Flight: Great aerial agility with vertical evasive maneuvers.
• Soothing Chant: Gently regenerates peaceful nearby allies.
awakening_system.bestiary.cloud_crane.dr: Celestial Crane Feather, Immortal Cloud Dew, White Jade.
awakening_system.bestiary.cloud_crane.lo: Sacred birds revered by immortal masters for their pure and incorruptible grace.

awakening_system.bestiary.cryo_hypostasi: • Inviolable Cube Shell: Immune to damage while cubes shield its core.

Crystalline Bloom, Shivada Jade, Frozen Crystal.

Daleth - Pure Ice Entity & Sacred Geometry
awakening_system.bestiary.demonic_cultiv: • Demonic Qi Sword: High-frequency crimson slashing waves unleashed at range.

Demonic Cultivation Manual, Murim Black Steel Sword, Blood Qi Pill.
Renegade martial artists who traded their souls to dark arts in pursuit of immortality and absolute dominance.
Interrupt his sword Qi channeling with heavy ranged throwing weapons.
Zealot of the Heavenly Demon Cult
awakening_system.bestiary.dendro_hyposta: • Inviolable Cube Shell: Immune to damage while cubes shield its core.

Quelled Creeper, Nagadus Emerald, Seed of Creation.

Zayin - Pure Life Entity & Sacred Geometry
awakening_system.bestiary.dokkaebi.abili: • Channel Broadcast: Links the room to Constellations watching in the night sky.
• Scenario Coins: Rewards hunters performing impossible heroic deeds.
• Broadcast Barrier: Repels underhanded strikes and illegal interference.
awakening_system.bestiary.dokkaebi.drops: Star Stream Coins, Dokkaebi Horn, Scenario Contract.
awakening_system.bestiary.dokkaebi.lore: Small horned winged beings orchestrating scenarios for the amusement of Constellations across the cosmos.
awakening_system.bestiary.dokkaebi.name: Dokkaebi

awakening_system.bestiary.dokkaebi.title: Streamer & Scenario Admin (Omniscient Reader)

• Astral Crescent: Curved pure-energy lunar projectiles.
• Zero Gravity: Distorts gravity, levitating hunters in its vicinity.
Stellar Fragment, Celestial Void Scales, Supernova Heart.

Star Devourer of the Dimensional Void
awakening_system.bestiary.dragon_celesti: • Celestial Dragon Breath: Sacred golden beam that purifies and vaporizes matter.
• Taoist Ascent: Fluid winding flight riding sacred mountain winds.
• Blessing of the Dao: Projects an aura that suppresses enemy demonic Qi.
Celestial Dragon Pearl, Sacred Whiskers, Concentrated Primordial Qi.
The supreme divine beast deity of the Murim realm, embodying perfect Yin and Yang harmony across the nine heavens.
Employ high-mastery sword techniques and avoid head-on clashes with his maw.
Sacred Eastern Dragon of the Nine Heavens (Murim)
awakening_system.bestiary.dragon_fire.ab: • Primordial Breath: Continuous cone of fire incinerating blocks and armor.
• Incandescent Tail Sweep: Wide arc tail blow knocking back multiple targets.
• Volcano Eruption: Summons fiery geysers from the ground beneath hunters.
awakening_system.bestiary.dragon_fire.dr: Fire Dragon Scales, Primordial Flame Heart, Ancient Dragon Horn.
awakening_system.bestiary.dragon_fire.lo: Ancient winged behemoths that dominated volcanic skies long before the first dimensional rifts opened.

Toxic Jade Scales, Pure Venom Gland, Ancient Leather.

Lure him away from dense foliage and consume milk or antidotes.
awakening_system.bestiary.dragon_ice.abi: • Absolute Glacial Breath: Freezing beam that roots targets and frosts the screen.
• Frosted Diamond Scales: Drastically reduces incoming physical damage.
• Frost Nova: Icicle detonation that slows all nearby hunters.
awakening_system.bestiary.dragon_ice.dro: Eternal Ice Scales, Draconic Glacial Ice, Frost Orb.
awakening_system.bestiary.dragon_ice.lor: Titanic beasts birthed atop the coldest peaks of arctic dimensions.
awakening_system.bestiary.dragon_ice.tac: Use warm armor or fire attacks to shatter his frost-covered defense.
awakening_system.bestiary.dragon_ice.tit: Lord of the Eternal Glacial Blizzard
awakening_system.bestiary.dragon_lightni: • Celestial Plasma Ray: Instant lightning discharge dealing heavy ranged damage.
• Lightning Flight: Superior flight speed leaving an electrified trail.
• Static Tempest: Electromagnetic paralysis across a wide area.
Thunder Scales, Electrified Horn, Primordial Lightning Core.
Draconic incarnation of celestial storms, capable of traveling as fast as thunderbolts.
Equip lightning rods or keep moving constantly to dodge its bolts.

• Shadow Meld: Turns translucent to evade attacks during night flights.
• Maw of Doom: Crushing bite that inflicts severe Wither.
Shadow Scales, Void Fragment, Dark Dragon Egg.
Creatures dwelling on the border between life and death, loyal to the breath of the abyss.
Use intense light sources and consecrated radiant projectiles.
Winged Nightmare of the Shadow Realm

• Revival Prisms: Generates 3 Electro prisms upon critical health that must be destroyed with elemental reactions.
Lightning Prism, Vajrada Amethyst, Pure Electro Fragment.

Wait out its Rock-Scissors-Paper combo to strike the core. Use Pyro, Cryo, or Dendro on final prisms.
Aleph - Pure Lightning Entity & Sacred Geometry

• Demon King's Wrath (Final Phase): Unleashes a chamber-wide meteor apocalypse.
Demon King Crown, Quad-Elemental Core, Mantle of Supreme Chaos.
A ruler of the abyssal plane who subjugated primeval elemental spirits into an empire of infinite chaos.
Swap equipment sets to counter the active element he is channeling at any moment.
Sovereign of the Four Chaotic Elements
awakening_system.bestiary.elemental_lord: • Pure Energy Barrage: Continuous volley of arcane spheres.
• Gale Shield: Deflects conventional arrows and physical projectiles.
• Earthen Nova: Circular rock shard burst that stuns in area.
Primordial Elemental Essence, Arcane Resonance Crystal, Storm Dust.
Living manifestations of the raw elemental forces governing the balance of the physical world.
Use void-infused weapons to breach his gale barrier.
awakening_system.bestiary.geo_hypostasis: • Inviolable Cube Shell: Immune to damage while cubes shield its core.
• Basalt Pillars: Erects massive stone columns to channel seismic strikes from afar.
• Seismic Hammer & Stone Rain: Slams down as a massive hammer or rains stone projectiles.

Basalt Pillar, Prithiva Topaz, Geo Mineral Core.

Gimel - Pure Earth Entity & Sacred Geometry
awakening_system.bestiary.goblin_scout.a: • Poison Dart: Blowgun darts tipped with corrosive poison.
• Horn Alarm: Sounds a horn calling nearby goblin reinforcements.
• Quick Evasion: Leaps backward when approached in melee range.

awakening_system.bestiary.goblin_scout.l: The eyes and ears of goblin tribes throughout D and C rank dungeons.
awakening_system.bestiary.goblin_scout.t: Stun him before he finishes blowing his alarm horn.

• Healing Totem: Plants a ward that regenerates health of allied goblins.
• Curse of Weakness: Reduces hunters' physical damage output in range.
Goblin Totem Staff, Ritual Feathers, Tribal Magic Stone.
Spiritual leader and elemental conjurer revered by subterranean tribes.

Warlock of the Totem & Tribal Flame
awakening_system.bestiary.goblin_warrior: • Furious Cleave: Consecutive savage strikes with a scrap sword.
• Shield Block: Deflects arrows and occasional frontal hits.
• Desperate Charge: Rapid burst of speed when health falls below 30%.
Goblin Iron Mace, Reinforced Wooden Shield, Sharp Teeth.
Warriors geared in rusted armor scavenged from fallen adventurers.
Break his shield with axes or heavy downward power strikes.
awakening_system.bestiary.hilichurl_bers: • Blazing Torch Rush: Charges straight forward engulfed in continuous flames.
• Fiery Windmill: Frantically swings his burning club, setting the surroundings ablaze.
• Berserk Fury: Increases attack speed upon receiving critical hits.
Stained Mask, Heavy Horn, Scorched Wood.
Hilichurls infused with reckless Pyro passion, rushing headlong into any intruder.
Dodge laterally during his charge; he remains exposed at the end of his run.
Fierce Warrior of the Blazing Torch
awakening_system.bestiary.hilichurl_shoo: • Elemental Arrow: Fires Pyro or Electro infused arrows from range.
• Evasive Hop: Quickly hops backward if approached in close quarters.
• Camp Alarm: Screeches to alert other hilichurls in the vicinity.
Damaged Mask, Firm Arrowhead, Copper Coins.
Primitive humanoid wanderers roaming the wilderness of Teyvat, wearing masks to conceal their faces.
Close in quickly using lateral dashes or raise a shield while he reloads his bow.
Tribal Archer of the Plains of Teyvat
awakening_system.bestiary.hydro_hypostas: • Inviolable Cube Shell: Immune to damage while cubes shield its core.
• Healing Drops & Water Dolphins: Launches water dolphins and spawns living drops sending healing orbs.
• Surging Waves & Downpour: Transforms into a vortex unleashing massive expanding tidal waves.
• Revival Water Droplets: Spawns 3 water droplets advancing slowly to restore its health.
Dew of Repudiation, Varunada Lazurite, Essence of Pure Tides.
Condensed elemental fluids attaining absolute liquid purity, flowing with both serenity and wrath.
Destroy healing droplets immediately with Cryo, Pyro, or Dendro so they never reach the core.
He - Pure Water Entity & Sacred Geometry
awakening_system.bestiary.ice_elf_assass: • Dual Frost Slash: Strikes rapidly, freezing the player's screen.
• Frost Dash: Instant slide upon gusts of frost.
• Smoke Vanish: Turns invisible and repositions upon taking damage.
Baruka Daggers (Ghost Moon), Frost Leather, Chilled Essence.
Silent hunters born in the frozen caverns of snow dungeons, swift as a white blizzard.

Agile Shadow of the Frozen Tundra
• Crimson Greatsword: Colossal slashes inflicting deep bleeding.
• Supersonic Dash: Instant thrust that shatters any shield guard.
• Throne Guard: Deploys withered knights with a suppression aura.
• Monarch's Fealty: Upon defeat, can be extracted as a Commander-rank shadow.
awakening_system.bestiary.igris.drops: Crimson Helm of Igris, Blood Longsword, Essence of Loyal Nobility.
awakening_system.bestiary.igris.lore: The noble cavalry commander who guarded the empty throne for centuries awaiting a worthy successor.
awakening_system.bestiary.igris.name: Igris
awakening_system.bestiary.igris.tactics: Dodge laterally when he raises his sword two-handed. His frontal reach is immense.
awakening_system.bestiary.igris.title: Blood-Red Commander of the Throne Hall
awakening_system.bestiary.isekai_slime.a: • Impact Absorption: Near-total immunity to fall damage and physical knockback.
• Spring Leap Slam: High-altitude downward crushing bounce.
• Cellular Division: Splits into smaller clones upon taking critical hits.
awakening_system.bestiary.isekai_slime.d: Isekai Slime Jelly, Absorption Essence, Viscous Core.
awakening_system.bestiary.isekai_slime.l: The most iconic monster of the Isekai realm, constantly underestimated by rookies until it splits.
awakening_system.bestiary.isekai_slime.t: Use fire or freezing magic to counter its gelatinous elasticity.
awakening_system.bestiary.jade_beast.abi: • Reinforced Jade Carapace: Reduces incoming physical damage by 60% and resists light projectiles.
• Jade Earthquake: Ground stomp cracking the floor and generating razor stone shards.
• Rhinodont Charge: Unstoppable frontal charge that bowls over light blocks.
awakening_system.bestiary.jade_beast.dro: Pure Jade Plates, Jade Earth Core, Imperial Beast Horn.
awakening_system.bestiary.jade_beast.lor: Ancient beasts that nourished themselves on mineral Qi from sacred jade veins over eons.

• Millennial Jade Greatsword: Gigantic blade producing 15-block wide seismic shockwaves.
• Resonant Jade Barrier: Damage-immune shield only broken by defeating his sentinels.
• Jade Laser Eye: Continuous green Qi optical beam that scorches ground.
• Colossal Earth Stomp: Uproots stone slabs hurling them as heavy missiles.

Roll beneath his legs when he raises the greatsword, and strike the seals on his back.
Titanic Golem of the First Emperor's Tomb
awakening_system.bestiary.jiangshi.abili: • Rhythmic Leaps: Unpredictable stiff jumps ignoring standard terrain obstacles.
• Rigor Mortis Claws: Piercing finger strikes that apply paralyzing poison.
• Yellow Talisman Ward: Immune to mental, dark, and bleeding effects.
awakening_system.bestiary.jiangshi.drops: Yellow Taoist Talisman, Ancient Imperial Silk, Murim Mummy Dust.

awakening_system.bestiary.jiangshi.name: Jiangshi

awakening_system.bestiary.jiangshi.title: Reanimated Corpse via Taoist Talisman (Murim)
awakening_system.bestiary.mana_cow.abili: • Concentrated Mana Milk: Milking yields magical milk restoring mana and purging poisons.

awakening_system.npc.acheron.blessing_de: §dTwilight edge and power of nihility granted (5 min).
awakening_system.npc.acheron.dialogue.0: I have walked along countless crimson rivers... Past and future fade into nothingness.
awakening_system.npc.acheron.dialogue.1: Rain never ceases along this path. Draw your blade only when prepared to shoulder the void.
awakening_system.npc.acheron.dialogue.2: Dreams and waking life intertwine. Remember your name before crossing the horizon.
awakening_system.npc.acheron.dialogue.3: Fear not the darkness; even in deepest nihility, a fleeting spark persists.
awakening_system.npc.acheron.title: Emanator of Nihility
awakening_system.npc.arthur_leywin.bless:
§eYou received §9Primordial Aether Core§e.
§7(Jump II, Speed II, and Slow Falling for 5 min)
awakening_system.npc.arthur_leywin.dialo: Mana fills the body, but aether governs the very dimensions of space and reality.
I fight not for titles or vain glory; I fight to ensure my loved ones have a tomorrow.
Purify your core. The clarity of your intent defines the strength of your awakening.
Learn to flow with your surroundings; brute force without control only breeds ruin.
awakening_system.npc.arthur_leywin.title: Ruler of Aether
awakening_system.npc.black_market_dealer: §dInvisibility, night vision, and speed granted (3 min).
Black chips leave no trace... and Mora asks no questions.
Looking for clandestine machinery or a pool duel where stakes have no ceiling?
What happens in this crypt stays hidden in underworld shadows.
Your eyes saw nothing, your hands only counted chips.
awakening_system.npc.casino_receptionist: Table fortune and distinguished high-roller charisma!
Welcome to the Grand Royal Casino of Teyvat! Here fortune and glamour converge under golden lights.
Looking to test your luck at the high-stakes tables? Get your VIP Pass to enter the exclusive high-roller lounge.
At our counter you can exchange Mora for Official Chips and request your VIP accreditation.
Remember that in VIP Blackjack and VIP Roulette, only the most coveted stakes in the entire realm are wagered.
awakening_system.npc.cha_haein.blessing_:
§eYou received §6Dance of the Light Sword§e.
§7(Haste II, Speed II, Jump Boost II for 5 min)
Your scent isn't like the other hunters'... Are you connected to the System?
The sword stance requires absolute focus. Never hesitate at the decisive moment.
Don't neglect your physical training; agility is everything when a Red Gate opens.
Whenever you draw your blade, remember who you are fighting for.
awakening_system.npc.cha_haein.title: S-Rank Hunter
awakening_system.npc.cha_yeonwoo.blessin:
§eYou received §4Black Dragon Wings§e.
§7(Fire Immunity for 10 min, Strength II and Slow Falling)
awakening_system.npc.cha_yeonwoo.dialogu: My brother left me a pocket watch and a diary. Every floor of this Tower will be conquered and purged.
The Black Dragon's wings devour false gods of the heavens.
If you scale the Tower of Desires, prepare never to look back.
Weakness is a sin in a realm governed by Constellations.
awakening_system.npc.cha_yeonwoo.title: The Hunter Cain
awakening_system.npc.cheon_yeowoon.bless:
§eYou received §cNano-Machine Circulation§e.
§7(Regeneration II for 3 min, Strength II and Speed II for 5 min)
awakening_system.npc.cheon_yeowoon.dialo: Nano, scan this hunter's meridians... Biological and energetic structure acceptable.
The Heavenly Demonic Cult bows its head to neither god nor emperor.
Absolute power needs no excuses; it is forged with millimeter precision and ruthless steel.
Cut down your enemy before their first thought of betrayal can form.
awakening_system.npc.cheon_yeowoon.title: Lord of the Demonic Cult
awakening_system.npc.chung_myung.blessin:
§eYou received §aMount Hua Bloom§e.
§7(Mining Haste III, Strength II, Speed II for 5 min)
awakening_system.npc.chung_myung.dialogu: Where's the plum blossom wine? And more importantly, where's Shaolin's money?!
At Mount Hua we don't surrender; we strike twice as hard until the enemy gets it!
Think 10,000 thrusts a day is hard? Back in my day we did 100,000 before breakfast!
Draw your sword. If you wield a blade, cut through doubts like plum blossoms in deep winter.
awakening_system.npc.chung_myung.title: Divine Dragon of Mount Hua
awakening_system.npc.diluc.blessing_desc:
§eDiluc has tempered your spirit with the flames of dawn.
§7(Fire Resistance 10m, Strength II 5m, Speed II 5m, Haste II 5m)
awakening_system.npc.diluc.dialogue.0: Welcome to Dawn Winery. A glass of grape juice before you continue on your way?
awakening_system.npc.diluc.dialogue.1: The Knights of Favonius are far too sluggish. Certain threats can only be quelled from the shadows.
awakening_system.npc.diluc.dialogue.2: The fire of dawn never flickers. Never let your guard down when night falls over Teyvat.
awakening_system.npc.diluc.dialogue.3: If you seek intel or respite in these lands, this winery's doors remain open.
awakening_system.npc.diluc.title: Tycoon of Dawn
§eYou received §6Adventurer Guild's Favor§e.
§7(Strength I, Speed I, and Hero of the Village for 5 min)
Welcome to the Adventurers Guild! Check the Bounty Board on the wall for hunting contracts.
Seeking glory and rightful rewards? Complete contracts to rank up all the way to mythical Rank S.
Don't forget to upkeep your gear at the upstairs smithing tables before heading into the wild.
Every beast slain in the guild's name earns you Adventurer Medals and realm-wide prestige.
awakening_system.npc.ellen_joe.blessing_: §9Fierce shark slash and speed granted (5 min).
Ugh... More overtime work? I just want my coffee candies and a nap.
If you get between me and the exit, I'll slice you to pieces before my shift ends.
Victoria Housekeeping leaves no loose ends or stains on the carpet.
Let's wrap this up fast... I hate it when work interrupts my break time.
awakening_system.npc.ellen_joe.title: Cleaner of Victoria Housekeeping
awakening_system.npc.ganyu.blessing_desc:
§eGanyu grants you the grace of celestial dew from mountain peaks.
§7(Night Vision 10m, Speed II 5m)
awakening_system.npc.ganyu.dialogue.0: Dawn dew soothes the heart... We must not delay Liyue's pending duties.
awakening_system.npc.ganyu.dialogue.1: Amos' Bow whispers with the icy wind; a clean, true shot dispels any threat.
awakening_system.npc.ganyu.dialogue.2: Have you rested enough? Overexertion clouds a hunter's precision.
awakening_system.npc.ganyu.dialogue.3: For the peace of mortals and the thousand-year pact of the Adepti.
awakening_system.npc.ganyu.title: General Secretary of the Qixing
awakening_system.npc.hoshimi_miyabi.dial: Section 6 in position. Every etheric distortion within the Hollows shall be eradicated.
The Shunguang Blade does not hesitate. Cutting speed surpasses thought itself.
Maintain composure before ethereals. Discipline is an operative's sharpest weapon.

awakening_system.screen.guide.casino.tex: Deep within the underworld, the Grand Casino offers high-stakes gambling with Mora and Chips.
Speak with Madame Valerie to obtain your VIP Pass and enter high-roller suites.
Deploy your own clandestine slot machine to collect chips spent by other players.
Jackpots and mega payouts are covered by the world System without draining your vault.
Play precision pool games and spin the Mora Roulette to multiply your fortune.
awakening_system.screen.guide.cultivatio: • Qi is separate from Mana. It does not regenerate passively or with potions: only by cultivating.
• Press [C] or /system cultivate to assume the lotus position and gather celestial Qi.
• 5 Realms: Qi Condensation -> Foundation Establishment -> Golden Core -> Nascent Soul -> Celestial Ascension.
• 9 Sub-levels per realm. Advancing resets Qi to 0 and increases passive gathering rate (+1 Qi/s per sub-level).
• Unlock meridians using Qi to boost speed, passive regeneration, damage, and break through bottlenecks.
• Lethal spiritual combat blade (+12 Damage). Right-click to mount and fly in 3D space.
• Look-directed control: press [W] to fly where you look. [Shift] to dismount, Sneak+Right-Click to retrieve it.
awakening_system.screen.guide.dungeons.t: • Dungeons are seamless complexes connected through 4 Magical Barrier Walls:
1. §fAbyssal Antechamber:§7 Sunken central pit with frontline vanguard enemies.
2. §fCrypt Passageway:§7 Gothic colonnades, iron barred cells, and lurking assassins.
3. §fWar & Magma Pit:§7 Sunken circular crucible, elevated catwalks, and Mini-Boss.
4. §fCathedral Nave:§7 12-block high vaulted ceiling with buttresses and necromancers.
5. §6Imperial Throne Hall:§e 3-tiered dais hosting the Supreme Boss (Igris / Baran).
• To dissolve a wall you must eliminate all enemies in the current stage.
• Each cleared wall grants extra time to the collapse timer.
• Defeating the Monarch in Stage 5 manifests the Roulette Altar for your loot. Return to Room 1 to cross the exit gate.
awakening_system.screen.guide.guilds.tex: Found your own Guild or join an existing one to share expeditions, quests, and storages.
Level up your guild to unlock passive group perks and expedition vaults.
Manage diplomatic treaties from the Alliances tab in the Guild menu [G].
Forging a pact grants mutual peace: prevents all friendly fire between allied guild members.
Breaking a pact immediately resumes hostility, opening sieges and S-rank dungeon disputes.
awakening_system.screen.guide.ranks.head: §6§l[FULL SYSTEM RANK SCALE (41 RANKS)]
§b§l[PORTAL COLOR CODING]
awakening_system.screen.guide.ranks.text: • §6Limitless (960) -> ABSOLUTE GOD (1000)§f [Supreme Entity of the Multiverse]
• Human Elite: EX (70) -> SS (90) -> SSS (110) -> §6National (130)§f [Mortal Peak]
• Deities: Supreme Being (350) -> Demigod (370) -> God (400) -> Deity (430) -> Ancestral (460)
• Absolute: Infinite (610) -> Omnipotent (640) -> Absolute Being (670) -> Absolute (700)
• Creation: Supreme Creator (730) -> Absolute Creator (760) -> Chaos Sovereign (800)
• Final Deities: Timeless Monarch (840) -> Astral Deity (880) -> Singularity (920)
• §bCyan:§f Ranks E/D | §aGreen:§f C/B | §6Amber:§f A | §cCrimson:§f S | §5Purple:§f SS to National
• §dOrchid:§f Monarchs | §eCelestial Gold:§f Deities (370+) | §4Red Gates:§f Extreme dungeons
awakening_system.screen.guide.skills.tex: • Only one player per world/server can hold each unique distinction:
2. §bDemon King of Salvation:§f Fourth Wall: Infinite (Massive heal & immunity).
4. §cDragon Emperor:§f Cosmic Dragon Breath (Total destructive beam).
• Slay enemies and extract their souls to build your imperial shadow army.
• §bAllied Immunity:§f Your shadow soldiers are completely immune to your own attacks.
• §bAuto-Teleport:§f If they stray farther than 16 blocks, they blink right behind you.
• Raise any skill to Level 10 to unlock its evolved form.
awakening_system.screen.guide.sponsors.t: • You are an Incarnation in the Star Stream. Constellations closely watch your trials.
• §bAny constellation§f can spontaneously donate Coins when witnessing legendary feats.
• When leveling up or clearing dungeons, you can open §eSponsor Selection§f.
• Signing with an Official Sponsor grants their exclusive §aStigma and Attributes§f.
• §dOther constellations will still donate and send messages like in the webtoon!§f
• §ePrisoner of the Golden Headband (Sun Wukong):§f +Strength, Jump Boost & Willpower.
• §8Abyssal Black Flame Dragon:§f +Attack Damage & Knockback Resistance.
• §fDemon-like Judge of Fire (Uriel):§f +Max Health & Holy Judgment.
• §bDemon King of Salvation (Kim Dokja):§f +Max Health, Defense & Intelligence.
awakening_system.screen.guide.system.tex: • Earn experience by mining ores, defeating creatures, and completing quests.
• Each level grants Attribute Points to forge your unique specialization.
• Vitality (Max health & regeneration) | Perception (Luck & critical hit)
• Chain 10 consecutive strikes without taking damage to enter §6Trance Mode§f.
• In Trance you gain §a+35% Damage§f, sonic movement speed, and overload particles.
• Upon reaching Level 50 you unlock your specialization: Hunter, Assassin, Mage, or Necromancer.
• Right-click while holding Awakening Coins to deposit them into your virtual balance instantly.
• Use the 'BANK' tab in the Shop to deposit or withdraw physical coin bundles.
awakening_system.screen.guide.teyvat.tex: Travel to Teyvat using the Celestial Portal or complete the Welkin Ascension quest.
Face the 7 elemental Hypostases and the Raiden Shogun in the Plane of Euthymia.
Use Primogems and Intertwined Fates to summon legendary weapons and travel companions.
Redeem Anemo and Geo Sigils at Souvenir Shops to gain Mora and relics.
Original Resin regenerates over time to claim boss and domain rewards.
Craft Condensed Resin at crafting benches to double rewards from expeditions.

awakening_system.screen.guide.tower.text: • Ascend through all 100 floors using a Tower Ticket or /system tower.
• Each floor is an enclosed chamber with ceiling, 4 structural pillars, and tier-themed walls.
• Enemy HP, attack damage, and armor scale strictly with floor level.
• Defeating all monsters unlocks the Shinsoo Ascension Portal to climb higher.
• The south exit portal and Return Scrolls preserve your highest checkpoint upon returning home.
• Awaiting on Floor 100 is the Grand Tower Administrator (6,500 HP) and Divine Guardians.
• Defeating him opens the Great Isekai Portal: System 2.0 Update and massive Constellation sponsorship.

Buy Betting Tickets at the booth and back your favorite runner for massive Mora prizes.

awakening_system.worn_book.vol_1.line_0: §0The expedition party has established its base camp
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_1.line_1: §0at the roots of the World Tree (Yggdrasil).
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_1.line_3: §0Our mana compasses point to the prime meridian:
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_1.line_6: §0The North-South axis could only be calculated by the
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_1.line_7: §0Astral Observatory (Vol. II). Seek both maps to locate
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_1.line_8: §0the dimensional rift leading to the martial lands: §c§lMurim§0.

awakening_system.worn_book.vol_2.line_0: §0Three moons of calculations using celestial astrolabes
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_2.line_1: §0have revealed the line of magnetic resonance.
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_2.line_6: §0Without the Hunters Alpha meridian (Vol. I), this parallel
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_2.line_7: §0is useless, and the ascension elevation threshold
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_2.line_8: §0remains sealed within the Primordial Chronicle (Vol. III).
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_2.title: §1§lASTRAL OBSERVATORY (VOL. II)
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_3.line_0: §0"In the Age of Myth, the Dao Sovereigns forged a sole
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_3.line_1: §0bridge bridging Magic and the Martial Continent."
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_3.line_3: §0The vortex rests within Yggdrasil's highest canopy:
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_3.line_6: §0Align the Hunters Alpha meridian (X from Vol. I)
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_3.line_7: §0with the Sages Beta parallel (Z from Vol. II).
awakening_system.worn_book.vol_3.line_8: §0At the pinnacle of these three markers, your soul shall ascend.

diorama.settings.title: Map settings
diorama.settings.gpu_baking.tooltip: Experimental. Draws map tiles on the graphics card instead of the processor, so they appear sooner and the game uses less CPU. The first tiles are also drawn the old way and compared; if your graphics card draws them differently, it switches itself off.
diorama.gpu_baking.failed: GPU baking didn't match on this graphics card, so Diorama is drawing the map on the processor again. The game log has the details.
diorama.settings.minimap_shown.tooltip: Shows the minimap in a corner of the screen.
diorama.settings.compass.tooltip: Puts N, S, W and E on the minimap's edges. The map always faces north.
diorama.settings.coordinates.tooltip: Shows your block coordinates under the minimap.
diorama.settings.biome.tooltip: Shows the biome you're in under the minimap.
diorama.settings.auto_caves.tooltip: When you're underground, the minimap and the map show the cave you're in instead of the surface above.
diorama.settings.corner.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the minimap sits in.
diorama.settings.size.tooltip: How wide the minimap is. It shrinks to fit a small screen.
diorama.settings.zoom.tooltip: How close the minimap is zoomed in. The zoom keys change it too.
diorama.settings.players.tooltip: Shows other players on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.hostile.tooltip: Shows monsters, like zombies and creepers, on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.neutral.tooltip: Shows mobs that only attack when provoked, like wolves, bees and endermen, on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.passive.tooltip: Shows animals, villagers and other harmless mobs on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.range.tooltip: Players and mobs farther above or below you than this are left off the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.chunk_grid.tooltip: Draws chunk borders on the map.
diorama.settings.slime_chunks.tooltip: Marks the chunks where slimes spawn on the map. Single player only, in the Overworld: it needs the world's seed.
diorama.settings.spawn_spots.tooltip: Marks blocks on the map where monsters can spawn: those dark even by day, or also those dark only at night.
diorama.settings.waypoints_map.tooltip: Shows your waypoints on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.waypoints_world.tooltip: Shows your waypoints in the world, with their distance, even through terrain.
diorama.settings.deaths.tooltip: Adds a waypoint where you die.
diorama.settings.outlines.tooltip: Darkens the edge where a block stands in front of lower ground, so cliffs and roofs stand out.
diorama.settings.rounded_fog.tooltip: Rounds off the edge of the explored map, instead of following the square edges of chunks.
diorama.settings.fog_of_war.tooltip: Cave maps show only the blocks you've seen, even where the server allows the full map.
diorama.settings.quality.tooltip: Fast fills in the map about four times sooner and draws simpler fog. For slower computers.
diorama.settings.type_outline.tooltip: Outlines mob heads in red, yellow or green for hostile, neutral or passive. Off, they're outlined in black.
diorama.settings.player_names.tooltip: Where other players' names show under their heads.
diorama.settings.arrow_color.tooltip: The colour of your own arrow on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.waypoint_labels.tooltip: What shows under waypoints in the world: the distance, plus the name when you're close or looking at it, always, or never.
diorama.folder.name: Folder name
diorama.folder.hint: Pick a waypoint's folder in its editor.
diorama.folder.taken: There's already a folder with that name
diorama.folder.empty: No waypoints in this folder yet
diorama.waypoint.folder_tooltip: The folder this waypoint is in. Click to move it to the next one; make folders in the waypoint list.
diorama.settings.icon_size.tooltip: How big players and mobs are drawn on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.frame.tooltip: The border around the minimap: the dark frame, a clean Minecraft edge, or none.
diorama.settings.shape.tooltip: Whether the minimap is a square or a circle.
diorama.settings.radar_style.tooltip: How players and mobs show: their heads as pixel art, faces in boxes framed by mob type, or plain coloured dots.
